name: astra-antigravity
description: Delegate implementation, analysis, research and document tasks from Codex to Antigravity.

interface.longDescription: Delegate coding, analysis, research from supplied sources, and document tasks from Codex to Antigravity on your computer. Requires local Python, Codex and Antigravity CLIs, your own accounts, and access to the selected model. Codex plans the task and checks the result. Supported hosts deliver decisions and results while Codex continues other work; other hosts wait for the task. Tasks can run commands, change files and use your provider quotas. Antigravity tool approval is automatic and its terminal sandbox is enabled by default. An isolated Git worktree separates changes, not all filesystem access. Provider terms and billing apply. The task does not inherit your conversation's web, browser or connector access. This is an independent plugin, not an OpenAI, Google or Anthropic product.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this task to Antigravity with the appropriate task type and independently verify the result.
